import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
import catboost as cb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import os

os.environ["LGBM_VERBOSE"] = "-1"
os.environ["XGB_VERBOSE"] = "0"


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in km
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


def bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    x = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2)
    y = np.cos(lat1) * np.sin(lat2) - np.sin(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.cos(dlon)
    bearing = np.arctan2(x, y)
    return (np.degrees(bearing) + 360) % 360


# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=2000000)
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Clean training data
train = train[(train["fare_amount"] >= 1) & (train["fare_amount"] <= 100)]
train = train[(train["passenger_count"] >= 1) & (train["passenger_count"] <= 6)]
train = train[
    (train["pickup_latitude"].between(40.4, 41.0))
    & (train["pickup_longitude"].between(-74.5, -73.5))
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"].between(40.4, 41.0))
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"].between(-74.5, -73.5))
]

# Extract date and time features
train["date"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"]).dt.date
test["date"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"]).dt.date
train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)
test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)


def feature_engineering(df, is_train=True, train_pickup_counts=None, date_stats=None):
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["is_weekend"] = df["day_of_week"].isin([5, 6]).astype(int)
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["is_peak_month"] = df["month"].isin([6, 7, 8, 12]).astype(int)

    # Haversine distance
    df["distance"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["distance"] = np.where(
        np.isinf(df["distance"]) | np.isnan(df["distance"]), 0.0, df["distance"]
    )

    # Directional differences
    df["dlat"] = df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"]
    df["dlon"] = df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"]
    df["abs_dlat"] = np.abs(df["dlat"])
    df["abs_dlon"] = np.abs(df["dlon"])
    df["manhattan_dist"] = df["abs_dlat"] + df["abs_dlon"]
    df["straight_line_ratio"] = np.clip(
        np.where(df["manhattan_dist"] == 0, 0, df["distance"] / df["manhattan_dist"]),
        1.0,
        5.0,
    )

    # Bearing feature
    df["bearing"] = bearing(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Directional features
    df["bearing_north"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 30) & (df["bearing"] <= 150)).astype(int)
    df["bearing_south"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 210) & (df["bearing"] <= 330)).astype(int)
    df["bearing_east"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 300) | (df["bearing"] <= 60)).astype(int)
    df["bearing_west"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 120) & (df["bearing"] <= 240)).astype(int)

    # Additional derived features
    df["lat_sum"] = df["pickup_latitude"] + df["dropoff_latitude"]
    df["lon_sum"] = df["pickup_longitude"] + df["dropoff_longitude"]
    df["dist_x_passenger"] = df["distance"] * df["passenger_count"]
    df["abs_dlon_x_hour"] = df["abs_dlon"] * df["hour"]
    df["log_distance"] = np.log1p(df["distance"])

    # Binned coordinates
    df["pickup_bin_lat"] = (df["pickup_latitude"] * 100).astype(int)
    df["pickup_bin_lon"] = (df["pickup_longitude"] * 100).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_bin_lat"] = (df["dropoff_latitude"] * 100).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_bin_lon"] = (df["dropoff_longitude"] * 100).astype(int)

    # Airport proximity features
    jfk_lat, jfk_lon = 40.6413, -73.7781
    lga_lat, lga_lon = 40.7769, -73.8740
    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], jfk_lat, jfk_lon
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"], df["pickup_longitude"], lga_lat, lga_lon
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], jfk_lat, jfk_lon
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"], df["dropoff_longitude"], lga_lat, lga_lon
    )

    # Major hub proximity features
    grand_central_lat, grand_central_lon = 40.7527, -73.9772
    penn_station_lat, penn_station_lon = 40.7510, -73.9936
    df["pickup_to_grand_central"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        grand_central_lat,
        grand_central_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_penn_station"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        penn_station_lat,
        penn_station_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_grand_central"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        grand_central_lat,
        grand_central_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_penn_station"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        penn_station_lat,
        penn_station_lon,
    )
    df["is_near_hub"] = (
        (df["pickup_to_grand_central"] < 1.0)
        | (df["pickup_to_penn_station"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_grand_central"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_penn_station"] < 1.0)
    ).astype(int)

    # Time-based distance interactions
    df["rush_hour"] = (
        (df["hour"] >= 6) & (df["hour"] <= 10) | (df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] <= 20)
    ).astype(int)
    df["dist_rush_hour"] = df["distance"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["log_dist_rush_hour"] = df["log_distance"] * df["rush_hour"]

    # Toll route indicators
    df["tunnel_direction"] = df["bearing_east"].astype(int) + df["bearing_west"].astype(
        int
    )

    # Bridge crossing indicators
    brooklyn_bridge_lat, brooklyn_bridge_lon = 40.7061, -73.9964
    df["pickup_to_brooklyn_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        brooklyn_bridge_lat,
        brooklyn_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        brooklyn_bridge_lat,
        brooklyn_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["bridge_toll_indication"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_to_brooklyn_bridge"] < 1.0)
            | (df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_bridge"] < 1.0)
        )
        & (df["straight_line_ratio"] > 1.1)
    ).astype(int)

    # Distance quartiles
    df["dist_cat"] = pd.cut(
        df["distance"], bins=[-1, 0.5, 2, 5, 10, 50], labels=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    ).astype(float)

    # Demand/supply proxy features
    if is_train:
        train_pickup_counts = (
            df.groupby(["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"])
            .size()
            .reset_index(name="ride_count")
        )
        fare_stats = (
            df.groupby(["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"])
            .agg(
                avg_fare=("fare_amount", "mean"),
                fare_std=("fare_amount", "std"),
                median_fare=("fare_amount", "median"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
        df = df.merge(
            train_pickup_counts,
            on=["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"],
            how="left",
        )
        df = df.merge(
            fare_stats,
            on=["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"],
            how="left",
        )
    else:
        df = df.merge(
            train_pickup_counts,
            on=["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"],
            how="left",
        )
        fare_stats = (
            train.groupby(["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"])
            .agg(
                avg_fare=("fare_amount", "mean"),
                fare_std=("fare_amount", "std"),
                median_fare=("fare_amount", "median"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
        df = df.merge(
            fare_stats,
            on=["pickup_bin_lat", "pickup_bin_lon", "hour", "day_of_week"],
            how="left",
        )

    df["ride_count"] = df["ride_count"].fillna(1)
    df["avg_fare"] = df["avg_fare"].fillna(
        train["fare_amount"].mean() if is_train else train["fare_amount"].mean()
    )
    df["fare_std"] = df["fare_std"].fillna(1.0)
    df["median_fare"] = df["median_fare"].fillna(train["fare_amount"].median())
    df["log_ride_count"] = np.log1p(df["ride_count"])
    df["ride_count_cat"] = pd.cut(
        df["ride_count"], bins=[0, 10, 50, 200, 1000, np.inf], labels=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    ).astype(float)
    df["fare_zscore"] = (df["avg_fare"] - df["avg_fare"].mean()) / (
        df["avg_fare"].std() + 1e-6
    )
    df["is_high_fare_zone"] = (df["avg_fare"] > train["fare_amount"].mean()).astype(int)

    # Night surcharge feature
    df["night_surcharge"] = ((df["hour"] >= 20) | (df["hour"] < 6)).astype(int)
    df["night_x_distance"] = df["night_surcharge"] * df["distance"]
    df["night_x_log_distance"] = df["night_surcharge"] * df["log_distance"]
    df["night_x_rush"] = df["night_surcharge"] * df["rush_hour"]

    # Weather-related aggregate features
    if is_train:
        date_stats = (
            df.groupby("date")
            .agg(
                daily_fare_mean=("fare_amount", "mean"),
                daily_fare_std=("fare_amount", "std"),
                daily_ride_count=("fare_amount", "count"),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )
    df = df.merge(date_stats, on=["date"], how="left")
    df["daily_fare_mean"] = df["daily_fare_mean"].fillna(df["daily_fare_mean"].mean())
    df["daily_fare_std"] = df["daily_fare_std"].fillna(df["daily_fare_mean"].std())
    df["daily_ride_count"] = df["daily_ride_count"].fillna(
        df["daily_ride_count"].mean()
    )

    # Airport-specific features
    df["is_jfk_trip"] = (
        ((df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 2.0) | (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 2.0))
        & (df["distance"] > 10.0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["is_lga_trip"] = (
        ((df["pickup_to_lga"] < 2.0) | (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 2.0))
        & (df["distance"] > 5.0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["airport_trip"] = df["is_jfk_trip"] | df["is_lga_trip"]

    # Toll route indicators
    brooklyn_battery_lat, brooklyn_battery_lon = 40.6061, -74.0102
    queens_midtown_lat, queens_midtown_lon = 40.7512, -73.9828
    hamilton_ansbury_lat, hamilton_ansbury_lon = 40.7035, -74.0167
    df["pickup_to_brooklyn_tunnel"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        brooklyn_battery_lat,
        brooklyn_battery_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_tunnel"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        brooklyn_battery_lat,
        brooklyn_battery_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_queens_tunnel"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        queens_midtown_lat,
        queens_midtown_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_queens_tunnel"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        queens_midtown_lat,
        queens_midtown_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_hamilton_ansbury"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        hamilton_ansbury_lat,
        hamilton_ansbury_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_hamilton_ansbury"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        hamilton_ansbury_lat,
        hamilton_ansbury_lon,
    )
    df["toll_crossing"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_to_brooklyn_tunnel"] < 1.5)
            | (df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_tunnel"] < 1.5)
        )
        | (
            (df["pickup_to_queens_tunnel"] < 1.5)
            | (df["dropoff_to_queens_tunnel"] < 1.5)
        )
        | (
            (df["pickup_to_hamilton_ansbury"] < 1.5)
            | (df["dropoff_to_hamilton_ansbury"] < 1.5)
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["toll_x_distance"] = df["toll_crossing"] * df["distance"]
    df["toll_x_log_distance"] = df["toll_crossing"] * df["log_distance"]
    df["efficiency_x_toll"] = df["straight_line_ratio"] * df["toll_crossing"]

    # Bridge features
    brooklyn_bridge_lat, brooklyn_bridge_lon = 40.7061, -73.9964
    manhattan_bridge_lat, manhattan_bridge_lon = 40.7158, -73.9875
    queensboro_bridge_lat, queensboro_bridge_lon = 40.7580, -73.9483
    george_washington_bridge_lat, george_washington_bridge_lon = 40.8538, -73.9784
    df["pickup_to_brooklyn_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        brooklyn_bridge_lat,
        brooklyn_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        brooklyn_bridge_lat,
        brooklyn_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_manhattan_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        manhattan_bridge_lat,
        manhattan_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_manhattan_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        manhattan_bridge_lat,
        manhattan_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_queensboro_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        queensboro_bridge_lat,
        queensboro_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_queensboro_bridge"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        queensboro_bridge_lat,
        queensboro_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["pickup_to_george_washington"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        george_washington_bridge_lat,
        george_washington_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["dropoff_to_george_washington"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        george_washington_bridge_lat,
        george_washington_bridge_lon,
    )
    df["crosses_brooklyn_bridge"] = (
        (df["pickup_to_brooklyn_bridge"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_brooklyn_bridge"] < 1.0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["crosses_manhattan_bridge"] = (
        (df["pickup_to_manhattan_bridge"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_manhattan_bridge"] < 1.0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["crosses_queensboro_bridge"] = (
        (df["pickup_to_queensboro_bridge"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_queensboro_bridge"] < 1.0)
    ).astype(int)
    df["crosses_george_washington"] = (
        (df["pickup_to_george_washington"] < 1.0)
        | (df["dropoff_to_george_washington"] < 1.0)
    ).astype(int)

    manhattan_north, manhattan_south = 40.82, 40.68
    manhattan_east, manhattan_west = -73.92, -74.05
    df["pickup_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] >= manhattan_south)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] <= manhattan_north)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] >= manhattan_west)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] <= manhattan_east)
    ).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_manhattan"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] >= manhattan_south)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] <= manhattan_north)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] >= manhattan_west)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] <= manhattan_east)
    ).astype(int)
    df["manhattan_trip"] = df["pickup_manhattan"] & df["dropoff_manhattan"]
    df["interborough_trip"] = (
        (df["pickup_manhattan"] & ~df["dropoff_manhattan"])
        | (~df["pickup_manhattan"] & df["dropoff_manhattan"])
    ).astype(int)
    df["bridge_rush_hour"] = (
        df[
            [
                "crosses_brooklyn_bridge",
                "crosses_manhattan_bridge",
                "crosses_queensboro_bridge",
                "crosses_george_washington",
            ]
        ].sum(axis=1)
    ) * df["rush_hour"]
    df["manhattan_rush_hour"] = df["manhattan_trip"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["manhattan_distance"] = np.where(
        df["manhattan_trip"] == 1, np.sqrt(df["dlat"] ** 2 + df["dlon"] ** 2), 0
    )
    df["northbound"] = (df["dropoff_latitude"] > df["pickup_latitude"]).astype(int)
    df["eastbound"] = (df["dropoff_longitude"] > df["pickup_longitude"]).astype(int)
    df["pickup_in_midtown"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.75)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] <= 40.78)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] >= -73.99)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.96)
    ).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_in_midtown"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.75)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] <= 40.78)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] >= -73.99)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.96)
    ).astype(int)
    df["midtown_trip"] = df["pickup_in_midtown"] & df["dropoff_in_midtown"]

    # Spatiotemporal interaction features
    df["pickup_manhattan_rush"] = df["pickup_manhattan"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["dropoff_manhattan_rush"] = df["dropoff_manhattan"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["pickup_manhattan_night"] = df["pickup_manhattan"] * df["night_surcharge"]
    df["dropoff_manhattan_night"] = df["dropoff_manhattan"] * df["night_surcharge"]
    df["airport_rush"] = df["airport_trip"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["airport_night"] = df["airport_trip"] * df["night_surcharge"]

    # Major corridor bearing deviations
    df["bearing_5th_ave"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 330) | (df["bearing"] <= 30)).astype(int)
    df["bearing_broadway"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 30) & (df["bearing"] <= 60)).astype(int)
    df["bearing_west_side"] = ((df["bearing"] >= 285) & (df["bearing"] <= 315)).astype(
        int
    )
    df["corridor_bearing"] = (
        df["bearing_5th_ave"] + df["bearing_broadway"] + df["bearing_west_side"]
    )
    df["corridor_bearing_rush"] = df["corridor_bearing"] * df["rush_hour"]
    df["corridor_bearing_night"] = df["corridor_bearing"] * df["night_surcharge"]
    df["corridor_bridge_interaction"] = (
        df[
            [
                "crosses_brooklyn_bridge",
                "crosses_manhattan_bridge",
                "crosses_queensboro_bridge",
                "crosses_george_washington",
            ]
        ].sum(axis=1)
    ) * df["corridor_bearing"]
    df["manhattan_rush_night"] = (
        df["manhattan_trip"] * df["rush_hour"] * df["night_surcharge"]
    )
    df["manhattan_bridge_rush"] = (
        (
            df[
                [
                    "crosses_brooklyn_bridge",
                    "crosses_manhattan_bridge",
                    "crosses_queensboro_bridge",
                    "crosses_george_washington",
                ]
            ].sum(axis=1)
        )
        * df["manhattan_trip"]
        * df["rush_hour"]
    )

    # Trip time estimation features
    speed_profile = {
        (True, True): 15,
        (True, False): 18,
        (False, True): 22,
        (False, False): 20,
    }
    df["is_rush"] = df["rush_hour"] == 1
    df["is_weekend_bool"] = df["is_weekend"] == 1
    df["speed_factor"] = df.apply(
        lambda row: speed_profile[(row["is_rush"], row["is_weekend_bool"])], axis=1
    )
    df["estimated_travel_time"] = df["distance"] / df["speed_factor"]
    df["speed_efficiency_ratio"] = df["distance"] / (df["estimated_travel_time"] + 1e-6)
    df["time_fare_multiplier"] = df["speed_efficiency_ratio"] / 20.0
    df["time_toll_interaction"] = df["estimated_travel_time"] * df["toll_crossing"]
    df["time_distance_interaction"] = df["estimated_travel_time"] * df["distance"]
    df["log_estimated_time"] = np.log1p(df["estimated_travel_time"])
    df["implied_speed"] = df["distance"] / (df["estimated_travel_time"] + 1e-6)

    # Fixed residual distance feature: use baseline predictions instead of residuals
    # Compute baseline model on training data only and apply to both train/test
    return df, train_pickup_counts, date_stats


# Feature engineering on training data
train, train_pickup_counts, date_stats = feature_engineering(train, is_train=True)

# Compute baseline model coefficients on training data (distance + hour + passenger_count)
# These will be used to generate baseline predictions for both train and test sets
X_baseline = train[["distance", "hour", "passenger_count"]].values
X_baseline_with_intercept = np.column_stack([X_baseline, np.ones(len(X_baseline))])
y_baseline = train["fare_amount"].values
baseline_coeffs = np.linalg.lstsq(X_baseline_with_intercept, y_baseline, rcond=None)[0]

# Generate baseline predictions for training set
train["baseline_fare"] = X_baseline_with_intercept @ baseline_coeffs

# Feature engineering on test data
test, _, _ = feature_engineering(
    test, is_train=False, train_pickup_counts=train_pickup_counts, date_stats=date_stats
)

# Generate baseline predictions for test set using the same coefficients
